parameters.query:
SELECT id FROM performance_db.invite_tokens
WHERE token = '{{ $json.token }}'
  AND expires_at > NOW()
LIMIT 1

=SELECT 
  id, 
  full_name, 
  email, 
  password_hash,
  CASE 
    WHEN password_hash IS NULL THEN 'null'
    WHEN TRIM(password_hash) = '' THEN 'empty'
    ELSE 'has_password'
  END as password_status,
  (SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(created_at)) * 1000)
    FROM performance_db.email_verification_codes c
    WHERE LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.safe_email }}'))) AS last_code_at_ms
FROM performance_db.users
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(email)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.safe_email }}'))
LIMIT 1

-- Удаляем старые коды для этого email
DELETE FROM performance_db.email_verification_codes
WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER('{{ $json.safe_email }}');

-- Вставляем новый код (действует 10 минут)
INSERT INTO performance_db.email_verification_codes (email, code, expires_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.safe_email }}', '{{ $json.code }}', NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes')
RETURNING id, code, expires_at
